text: An altar where sleepless souls give nightmares as offerings. Defeat the twisted army of nightmares and the evil spell-cursed horde, and rule over this forbidden realm. Difficulty Death Limit Time Limit Easy 5 18:00 Normal 3 16:00 Hard 2 14:00 Challenge 2 13:00

In a cave stained with blood and darkness, a tyrant and his followers continue their bizarre rituals. You must defeat them and rule over forgotten time. Difficulty Death Limit Time Limit Easy 5 18:00 Normal 3 16:00 Hard 2 14:00 Challenge 2 13:00

A sanctum filled with endless resentment and blood-stained loathing. You must destroy the minions who feed on hatred together with their master, and conquer the cursed power. Difficulty Death Limit Time Limit Easy 5 18:00 Normal 3 16:00 Hard 2 14:00 Challenge 2 13:00

A subspace of distorted time and space, where forgotten fates are sealed away. You must eliminate those who guard chaos and redirect the flow of these fates. Difficulty Death Limit Time Limit Easy 5 18:00 Normal 3 16:00 Hard 2 14:00 Challenge 2 13:00

An underground repository that was been buried underneath the earth for many years, forgotten, until marauders turned it into a hideout and slaughterhouse. Defeat the band of ruthless, headhunting ruffians and their leader. Difficulty Death Limit Time Limit Easy 5 18:00 Normal 3 16:00 Hard 2 14:00 Challenge 2 13:00

An underground tomb that has been reduced to a testing site for disturbing necromancy. Eliminate the necromancers performing forbidden rituals and their twisted experimental creations. Difficulty Death Limit Time Limit Easy 5 18:00 Normal 3 16:00 Hard 2 14:00 Challenge 2 13:00

All towers feed one shared point ladder — each threshold unlocks the rewards below. (The Elyos and Asmodian tracks are identical.)
